name_reason: Conforms to game-global naming: data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>. Domain 'chapter_event_handler_27' uses 27 = hex dispatch idx 0x27 into the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (a meaningful slot index matching its sole consumer fd2_chapter_event_handler_27__unref_drop, and consistent with sibling handler names 28/29/33/37 in the same file), not a Ghidra address residue. Descriptor 'drop_entry_inline' accurately reflects the datum: an inline 3-byte battle-drop-entry record baked into the binary. Name correctly conveys both purpose and that it is an inline record/blob.
purpose: Inline 3-byte battle drop-entry record (baked constant at 0x52742) read only by fd2_chapter_event_handler_27__unref_drop; encodes a single drop of item id 0xD3 (光之眼) to the stepping char.
logic_summary: Static 3-byte blob {0x00, 0xD3, 0x00} laid out per the drop-entry ABI consumed by fd2_process_battle_drop_entries: byte[0] = entry type (0 = ITEM pickup), byte[1..2] = little-endian uint16 value. Value 0x00D3 = item id 0xD3. The handler copies the 3 bytes onto a local stack slot (original: MOVSW + MOVSB at 0x34F85/0x34F8A) and passes &local as a one-entry drop-entry array to fd2_process_battle_drop_entries(recipient, 1, &local). The drop dialog opens only when the recipient is on the player team (team == 2); otherwise the entry is consumed silently. No RNG, no computation, no branch.
element_semantics: byte[0] = drop-entry type tag (0x00 = ITEM pickup, per fd2_process_battle_drop_entries: 0=item, 1=gold, 2=battle-event, 3=scripted-dialog); byte[1..2] = little-endian uint16 entry value = 0x00D3, interpreted as item id 0xD3 (光之眼) for a type-0 entry.
notes: Const-ness confirmed: only xrefs are READ + DATA from fd2_chapter_event_handler_27__unref_drop (0x34F8A READ / 0x34F85 DATA); no writers; resides in .object2 rodata; src declares const uint8[3]. Existing Ghidra data plate is stored as a PRE_COMMENT (not PLATE_COMMENT) and is semantically accurate/consistent with the src conclusion (byte[3] inline drop-entry, 00 D3 00, ABI layout, consumed by handler 27 unref, System=chapter battle item drop); left untouched per 'consistent plate -> do not modify' rule. Its minor caller-address rounding (notes 0x34F70 vs true entry 0x34F74) is a plate detail, not a content contradiction, and src is the source of truth. Item 0xD3 verified via fd2-knowledge = 光之眼 (進入隱藏關物品, use HP+200). src comment block at chevt1.c lines 1741-1746 already accurate/precise/ASCII -> kept; no src edit, so chevt1.c not staged.
